description.zh:
任务的可见性。
- PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
- PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
description.en:
The visibility of the Tensorboard instance. Valid values:
- PUBLIC: visible to all members in the workspace.
- PRIVATE: visible only to you and administrators in the workspace.

description.zh: Tensorboard展示名称。
description.en: The display name of the Tensorboard instance.

description.zh: 查询区间的截止时间。使用Tensorboard的创建UTC时间来过滤。若为空，则默认为当前时间。
description.en: The end time of the query range. Tensorboard instances are filtered by their creation time in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is the current time.

description.zh: 根据DLC任务ID来过滤Tensorboard任务。参见[ListJobs](~~459676~~)获取任务ID。
description.en: The DLC job ID used to filter Tensorboard instances. Call [ListJobs](~~459676~~) to obtain the job ID.

description.zh:
排序顺序。
- desc：降序。
- asc：升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- desc: descending order.
- asc: ascending order.

description.zh: 分页查询，指定当前需要返回的页码，起始值为1。
description.en: The page number for paging. The value starts from 1.

description.zh: 分页查询中，指定每页返回的Tensorboard数量。
description.en: The number of Tensorboard instances to return on each page for paging.

description.zh:
Tensorboard任务的付费类型。
- Free代表使用了免费资源的Tensorboard任务。
- Postpaid代表使用了后付费资源的Tensorboard任务。
description.en:
The billing method of the Tensorboard instance. Valid values:
- Free: a Tensorboard instance that uses free resources.
- Postpaid: a Tensorboard instance that uses pay-as-you-go resources.

description.zh:
资源配额ID。
> - 当前仅白名单用户可以使用资源配额资源创建Tensorboard任务，若需要使用该功能，请和我们联系。
> - 当前仅当Tensorboard任务使用资源配额的资源时，该值有效。
description.en:
The resource quota ID.
> - Currently, only whitelisted users can use resource quota resources to create Tensorboard instances. To use this feature, contact us.
> - This parameter takes effect only when the Tensorboard instance uses resource quota resources.

description.zh: 是否只返回当前登录者所创建的Tensorboard。
description.en: Specifies whether to return only Tensorboard instances created by the current user.

description.zh:
按返回的以下字段排序。
- DisplayName：任务名称。
- GmtCreateTime：任务创建时间。
description.en:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:
- DisplayName: the job name.
- GmtCreateTime: the job creation time.

description.zh: 数据来源ID。参见[ListJobs](~~459676~~)获取任务ID。
description.en: The data source ID. Call [ListJobs](~~459676~~) to obtain the job ID.

description.zh: 数据来源。目前仅支持DLC训练任务，即job。
description.en: The data source type. Currently, only DLC training jobs are supported, which means the value is job.

description.zh: 查询区间的起始时间。使用Tensorboard的创建UTC时间来过滤。若为空，则默认为当前时间的7天之前。
description.en: The start time of the query range. Tensorboard instances are filtered by their creation time in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 7 days before the current time.

description.zh:
Tensorboard状态：
- Creating：创建中。
- Running：运行中。
- Stopped：已停止。
- Succeeded：已成功。
- Failed：已失败。
description.en:
The Tensorboard status. Valid values:
- Creating: being created.
- Running: running.
- Stopped: stopped.
- Succeeded: succeeded.
- Failed: failed.

description.zh: 根据Tensorboard ID，来过滤Tensorboard列表。
description.en: The Tensorboard ID used to filter the Tensorboard list.

description.zh: 用户ID。
description.en: The user ID.

description.zh: 用户名。
description.en: The username.

description.zh:
是否显示详情。
- true：显示详情。
- false：不显示详情。
description.en:
Specifies whether to display details.
- true: Display details.
- false: Do not display details.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。根据工作空间ID来获取Tensorboard列表。<props="china">参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)获取工作空间ID。</props>
description.en: The workspace ID. Tensorboard instances are filtered by workspace ID. <props="china">Call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.</props>.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dlc list-tensorboards --verbose true --workspace-id 380 --source-type job --source-id dlc-xxxxxx --display-name TestTensorboard --status Running --start-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-09T14:45:00Z --sort-by GmtCreateTime --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --order desc --job-id dlc-xxx --tensorboard-id tensorboard-xxx --show-own false --payment-type Postpaid --user-id 16100003000 --username she0000mo --quota-id quota12000 --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
